description: Source code for internal implementation of absl::container::internal::raw_hash_set, including functions for managing hash table control bytes, rehashing, and slot management.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Internal class managing groups of control bytes in hash table.

methods.name: RandomSeed
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random seed based on thread-local or atomic counter.

methods.name: EmptyGeneration
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a static empty generation object, used for versioning.

methods.name: should_rehash_for_bug_detection_on_insert
methods.description: Determines if rehashing is needed for bug detection based on control bytes and capacity.

methods.name: ShouldInsertBackwards
methods.description: Decides whether to insert an element backwards based on hash and control bytes.

methods.name: ConvertDeletedToEmptyAndFullToDeleted
methods.description: Converts control bytes from deleted to empty and full to deleted states.

methods.name: find_first_non_full_outofline
methods.description: Finds the first non-full slot for a given hash outside inline functions.

methods.name: DropDeletesWithoutResize
methods.description: Removes deleted entries from hash table and rehashes if necessary.

methods.name: EraseMetaOnly
methods.description: Erases an element's metadata without resizing the hash table.

methods.name: ClearBackingArray
methods.description: Clears or resets the hash table's backing array, optionally reusing memory.
